nom: Personal Day Even Keel Resurfacing Peel

avis.texte: I have sensitive dry skin with blackheads on my nose and chin. This is a good exfoliation peel for once a week. I don't need to use any exfoliating toners with this in my routine.

I found this product does a great job of making my skin smoother. I have combo skin, but would get little bits of flaky skin here and there. This helps solve that issue and I feel like my skin looks and feels better the next day.
I'm really loving this product. My skin is looking healthier and healthier
I love how gentle this product is while still putting in the work! It's perfect for my sensitive, acne-prone skin. Will repurchase.
a gentle enough formula that doesn't irritate my skin or acne. Love this stuff

Personal day is a great line all around… anything I've tried I've absolutely loved. The peel is another love. First time after using it my skin felt so soft. It's a nice lactic acid treatment. I use it at least 2x week if not 3x week… personal day is just a fabulous line. I normally stay away from celebrity lines but lili reinhart deserves all her flowers for these products. ((Just use a thin layer. I like to wash my face and put it on in the shower.. wait 10 mins, rinse and dry with clean skin club towels than add the dieux deliverance serum snd followed by the moisturizer by personal day)) Only thing I would consider changing in the future is the packaging… to me this should be in a pump or tube.
Finally found something to clear my acne that didn't destroy my barrier. Will definitely repurchase.

Have been using this peel consistently for the past month once a week followed by the recovery mask and can already see a difference in my skin! It's definitely decreasing the visibility of my discoloration and acne scarring, hoping to see more results with continued use!
Noticed a huge difference in my acne scars after the first use. Three weeks in, and it really helped clear up my skin

I've tried enough "gentle" peels to be cynical, but this one earned its keep. The mix of four acids sounds intense, but my sensitive skin handled it without redness or dryness. Ten minutes, rinse, and my skin genuinely looks clearer and smoother. A little goes a long way!
A nice weekly refresh for the skin! Gently exfoliates without frustrating the skin too much. Great to pair with the everybody stay calm recovery mask!
My skin felt so smooth, clean and fresh following the use of the is peel. Thank you!

I have sensitive, acne prone skin and this product works wonders! I've used resurfacing products in the past that were far too intense and damaging for my skin, but this one is the perfect balance between gentle and effective.

I was impressed with this stuff. I have pretty sensitive skin (rosacea, acne) but I use this once a week and haven't had a single flare up. It's a resurfacing peel so of course there's peeling but in a gentler way than most I've used. Others gave me very visibly dry/scaly looking skin under my makeup but this one corrects where it needs it and leaves my skin super soft. I'll definitely buy again.

Noticed visibly soft and smooth skin after my first use. Have been using a few times a week and am really loving it so far. Super gentle for my sensitive skin and I notice it helps with my oil production and keeping my pores clean and cleared.
I use about once a week to keep my pores fresh and continue to work on my sun spots! I have about 6 on back stock just so I never run out 😊
I love that this peel is not harsh on my combo skin. I am recommending this to all my friends!
This really does the trick but it's also not super harsh or drying! Yet another incredible product from this brand!

I received this as a GWP when I bought the face wash and face lotion from Personal Day. I was not impressed with those products at all, both of them made my hormonal (adult) acne worse. However, I was pleasantly surprised with the efficacy of this peel. It doesnt lighten hyperpigmentation from past pimples quite as well as I would have liked, but using this twice a week has actually helped keep my acne in check. I use the first aid beauty retexturizing lotion with niacinamide, mario badescu azaleic acid serum, and the Rael miracle clear exfoliating face wash. This routine has done wonders for my 37yo acne!
I love this peel! It's made such a difference, making my skin consistently clear and smooth. Definitely one of my must have products!

I have only used the peel once so far, but I saw results very quickly. It revealed some of my pimples, but by the next morning they shrunk down so much! I think this will be a game changer in my routine.
This product is so good it burns, literally, but it's only the first minute or so and then a day or two later I can see my skin clearing out and it's appearance is brighter!
I was very satisfied with the Even Keel Resurfacing Peel. The product totally changed my skin within a week of use.
This reallyyyyy sticks to your skin and feels hard to fully rinse off. I also think it's a bit too strong for my sensitive/dry-leaning skin. Would probably be better for those with oily skin.

I'm not sure if it was this product or the spray or both together (my fault for introducing both around the same time I was so excited to try) but my skin was NOT happy. My forehead blew up in breakouts and my cheeks and chin had big cystic pimples. Still recovering a week later after stopping use :( i still have high hopes it wasn't these products but nothing else really changed. Hoping to try again but next time one product at a time!

I really wanted to love this product. However it almost immediately starts burning the second I put it on. I tried several times and each time my face felt like it was on fire! I ended up gifting this to a friend. She tried using it twice and similar to me she said it burned. She however said it only burned while it was wet, once it dried her face felt fine. She ended up getting rid of it. So overall I'd recommend passing on this mask. I love all of the other Personal Day products and none of the other products have this sensation when I use it.
I've been using this for over a month and wow… the results! Really does the job and it's not leaving my skin dry or flaky!
I haven't seen major results yet. My skin takes well to peels so I'm looking forward to see what it looks like in a few months.
Made my spots shrink after one use. I really only use it twice a week and have been very satisfied with it.

This is the first peel product I've used that doesn't irritate my skin or leave lasting redness. My skin feels smooth and I feel like it is really getting into my pores. Would recommend to anyone, especially if you have sensitive skin.
I have had bad cystic and hormonal acne for the last year, and this peel helps SO much! I do it twice a week, and I've already noticed a big improvement in my skin.
Personal day has never disappointed me! This resurfacing peel is amazing and I recommend it to everyone!!

I can tell it's working, I use it twice a week and after use I wake up each morning with new pimples brought to the surface…. I'm hoping soon it will be fully cleared soon! I've been using it for about 2 and a half weeks at this point and am patiently waiting for the purging stage to be over.. I read it can be normal when starting for skin to break out a little more while it purges everything from the skin. I can definitely tell it's starting to clear up tho, and I'm very excited! Also!! I've always had very under the surface pimples around my chin that were very hard to get to, and would always end up becoming huge big painful cystic acne zits, this has brought all those little ones under the skin to the surface and started clearing it out! Very excited for that!!

avis.titre: good texture, not irritating, slow acting
avis.texte: I have super sensitive skin, so exfoliating products are always a hit or miss for me. no irritation at all!
I use this mask about once a week, such a great addition to my routine and reset for my skin.
I live in a dry climate and have older skin and this product does not dry my skin. I noticed smoother skin after the first use. I like the results and will keep using.

This is such a gentle but effective mask! I love how it leaves my face feeling soft and like a I got a deep clean whenever I use it. I'm not good at remembering to use it regularly but I still notice a difference in my skin after each use!
Perfect for blackheads! I've been using it for a couple weeks and I've seen a significant difference in my nose and forehead!

My skin is extremely sensitive so I was nervous about trying this product out. But totally worth it! No irritation issues. When you use the product it's a little tingly but in a good way not in a way that feels like it's hurting my skin. I'm currently using the entire Personal Day line & love everything!

avis.titre: trust me a little goes a long way
avis.texte: this item is amazing for minimizing your incoming acne. warning if you have open acne and are using this it will sting a little but it will soothe out. just remember for the next time you use it to avoid that area until it heals.
My skin has been doing very well with the 3 step starter kit and I added this to clean my pores a little more. A few small blemishes arose but I think that's normal and they went away quickly.
Such an amazing product. Whenever my acne is acting up this is the best mask to start clearing my face up.
Really impressed with this one and seeing results over a few weeks!

I have sensitive skin but this was gentle and didn't irritate me. The tingling sensitive they warn you about was minimal and not uncomfortable at all! I usually follow this mask with the 'Everybody Stay Calm' mask which works great for me as well. I would def recommend!

the cleansing powder is my ultimate holy grail so of course i had to branch out & buy more products from this line! thankfully i did because adding this to my routine a couple times a week has been a game changer! i love how all the ingredients are natural & you don't have to worry about it burning or having any discomfort.

I've suffered with blackheads and sensitive skin my entire life. This is the first resurfacing mask product that has actually helped almost completely get rid of my blackheads and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It also gives a beautiful glow!
I have perioral dermatitis and was afraid to use any actives or exfoliation on my face. This mask helps clear my skin and leaves it so soft and smooth! An absolute necessity.
I'm so pleased to find a mask that's gentle enough for my skin but still works. Thanks, Personal Day!

I am in my mid 30s with frequently clogged pores and blackheads. Not only does using this 1-2 times a week help keep my pores clean, but I've noticed my fine lines diminished as well. Love that it's a multitasker!
Love love this face mask!! I was able to tell a difference in my skin texture after one use. Makes my skin look so good the next day when I do it the night before.
It's so refreshing! It burns a little but I know that's because it's working! I've only been using it once a week because normally masks dry my face. But this hasn't done that! Absolutely love it!

Not joking. This literally saved my wedding day! I had 3-4 new pustules and an atypical-for-me cyst forming the week of my wedding due to stress, and they were all drained and flat by the big day. For reference, I use this as a weekly peel and for spot treatment. Truly SO grateful to have found Personal Day when I did!

It took me three uses to decide I loved it! My face is so smooth and soft, and it does kick up some small whiteheads after I use (but that's normal, imo, from the exfoliation). Can't get enough of it and will definitely rebuy!
I love the resurfacing peel, makes my skin feel fresh and soft after using.
I don't leave on longer than about 2-5 minutes because i have sensitive skin but this always leaves my problem areas feeling smooth .

I use this peel every 2-3 days as recommended right before following up with the mask. My skin stung a bit the first few times I used the peel, but I take that as the product working. Don't be too discouraged if you notice more breakouts the next day, it's the peel bringing the gunk to the surface so it can leave your skin. I've been using the peel for almost 2 months. My blemishes overall are easier to extract than they used to be before using Personal Day products. I use the cleanser, acne treatment, moisturizer, peel, and mask.
It feels intense, but not painful like some other peels I have tried before.

I have very sensitive acne prone skin and this product is gentle yet effective. I've been using 1x a week for about a month and half and it's been keeping my breakouts in check. I will be using some more to see how it deals with my acne scars.

I'm not sure I'd notice too many positive results after a month, but there are certainly no adverse reactions. My skin feels very nice after and I have had a reduction in acne. My skin seems to be fine for a long time and then I randomly get a cycle of pimples, so I'm not sure if my clear skin is a result of this or just because it feels like behaving. I will re-order and I do want to try the calming mask next.
I like that I can feel the peel working with tingles as it dries. A little bit goes a long way and perfect end to my week using it once a week. ☺️
I love this peel! It has made my skin glowing and smoother. I am obsessed with the results!
The whole Personal Day line, changed my life and my skin. I love every single product!! Highly recommended
My skin always looks amazing after using this peel. I currently battle with perioral dermatitis and this peel in combination the normal system has done wonders for my skin!

Love the packaging of all the products. The texture of this peel is so luxurious. It goes deep enough to clean off all the dead skin and make you feel renewed but gentle enough not to burn your face off.
Easy to use, not too harsh and very effective. I use it twice a week. Excellent product

This is probably the fastest-working skincare product I've ever used. I noticed a difference in my skin after just a few uses. It gently smooths out my texture, brightens my complexion, and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and renewed. If you're looking for quick and noticeable results, this peel is definitely worth it!

I love this. I've used the Dr. Dennis Gross peel pads and while I like them, I don't love the environmental impact with individual wipes in wrappers. I bought this since the ingredients are similar, but no waste! I think this definitely provides a similar exfoliation experience. It's just tingly enough that I know the active ingredients are working, but it's not irritating at all. I'm 27 and have been acne prone since 14, I feel like this does help clear breakouts quicker than other things I've used.

avis.titre: Staple in my skin care routine
avis.texte: I use this weekly. I love the tingle in the beginning and how my skin feels afterwards. It has truly transformed my skin.

I have really sensitive skin so the idea of a peel was a little scary to me. However, I just love this one! It is so effective and my skin feels amazing after I use it! Using this and then applying the Everybody Stay Calm Recovery Mask right after is golden for my skin! I love how it doesn't feel too intense and how it feels like it's genuinely working when I have it on. Also, I really appreciate how it has the recommended amount to use and time limit on the packaging. It's super helpful!

This is the product I'd suggest if you can only get one personal day item. I use it once a week, sometimes twice, and my skin always looks better the next day. My active pimples decrease, and the inflammation of my cyst go away. It really feels like the kind of peel I get when I go to a salon and get a facial.

I've been using the even keel resurfacing peel at least 2-3 times a week and I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin texture. It stings initially but that means it's working! For background, I have uneven, textured skin with periodic acne breakouts due to stress or diet. The peel has been amazing in not only reducing my breakouts but also giving me the healthiest glow that I never see from any other products I use.
